sources.note: Detailed Conditions of Tenure (September 2026): degrees eligible for study, standard, one-year and doctoral tenure
Scholars can apply for most full-time postgraduate courses in almost any field
Course choice guidance: refers to the Conditions of Tenure and to Oxford's graduate course listing

subject_rule: Open in field: Rhodes Scholars may read for almost any full-time postgraduate degree in almost any field offered by the University of Oxford; the limits are on degree type and a few named courses (no PGCert or PGDip, no part-time courses, no accelerated graduate-entry Medicine, no DClinPsych or courses requiring NHS employment), not on subject.

programmes.name: MSc (one-year taught master's)
programmes.detail: Two successive one-year taught master's degrees are allowed on standard tenure, subject to the Trust's restrictions; a single one-year master's can also be taken on a one-year tenure

programmes.name: MSt (one-year taught master's)
programmes.detail: As for the MSc: two successive one-year taught degrees on standard tenure, or one year on a one-year tenure

programmes.name: MFA (one-year taught master's)
programmes.detail: As for the MSc: two successive one-year taught degrees on standard tenure, or one year on a one-year tenure

programmes.name: BCL (one-year taught master's)
programmes.detail: As for the MSc: two successive one-year taught degrees on standard tenure, or one year on a one-year tenure

programmes.name: Master of Public Policy (MPP)
programmes.detail: Professional degree: one-year tenure only, annual limits on numbers

programmes.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
programmes.detail: Professional degree: one-year tenure only, annual limits on numbers; at least two years of full-time work experience required (FAQ)

programmes.name: Master of Financial Economics (MFE)
programmes.detail: Professional degree: one-year tenure only, annual limits on numbers

programmes.name: DPhil, direct entry
programmes.detail: Up to three years of fees and stipend; conditional on Oxford admission and approval by the Rhodes Academic Review Board; open to those with a master's qualification in any of Oxford's four academic divisions, and usually to undergraduate-degree holders for the Science Divisions (Mathematical, Physical and Life Sciences; Medical Sciences)

programmes.name: DPhil through a one-year master's (1+3 pathway)
programmes.detail: Up to four years in total; very few places; the one-year master's is preparation for a DPhil, mainly in the Humanities and Social Sciences Divisions

programmes.name: Integrated four-year DPhil programmes (MPLS Doctoral Training Centre and Medical Sciences Doctoral Training Centre)
programmes.detail: Only if another funder pays at least one year and the Review Board approves

notes: The Rhodes Trust publishes no list of eligible subjects or courses. Its pages state the rule (almost any full-time postgraduate degree at Oxford) and point to Oxford's own A-Z listing of graduate courses for the courses themselves. Recorded here: 10 master's degree types and 3 doctoral routes that the Trust's conditions name. Oxford's full course list could not be read (see fetch problems).

Not eligible, as the Trust states: PGCert and PGDip courses (including the PGCE); part-time courses; the four-year Accelerated Graduate-Entry course in Medicine; the DClinPsych and other courses requiring NHS employment; the MPhil-to-DPhil route (five-year fee liability). Courses that need a term or more at another university must be queried with the Trust. Some Medical Sciences graduate degrees are covered but the FAQ names none.

The conditions also allow a second undergraduate degree, a BA with Senior Status over two years (Second BA), on the standard tenure; it is not recorded as a level because the scholarship is a postgraduate award.
Doctoral tenure is approved only after selection, through a further competitive process; candidates are advised to hold a two-year standard-tenure plan too.
